description: List EDI transactions, newest first: partner, document type (850 purchase order, 855 acknowledgment, 856 ship notice, 810 invoice, 997 functional ack, 846 inventory advice), direction, status, control and PO numbers, error, linked sales order, invoice or shipment, and timestamps. Filter by tradingPartnerId, direction, status, documentType or a search over control and PO numbers. Paged (page, pageSize up to 200). Open one with get_edi_transaction. Requires an operator (unpinned) credential.

search.description: Case-insensitive text to find in the control or purchase order number.

status.description: received, validated, validation_failed, processing, processed, processing_failed, queued, sent, send_failed, acknowledged, rejected or manual_review.

name: list_edi_transactions
title: List EDI Transactions
